title: Recurrence escalation rule: a recurring promoted pattern escalates to a durable owner
action: In Promotion Decision Tree add a recurrence-escalation step: when an ALREADY-promoted pattern recurs (its violation happens again despite the doc), the capture step must answer whether it can become a hook denial, guard, doctor check, or test; record the chosen durable owner (filed as a tiny/small cell when it cannot ship in-feature) or a one-line recorded reason why prose stays. In SKILL.md Compound step 4 add one sentence naming the rule. Then run the regen chain inside this cell, in order: bee dev render-skill-trees, bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, bee dev release-manifest --write.

truths: Recurrence of a promoted pattern triggers the durable-owner question, not another doc line
Doc-only survival requires a recorded reason
Regen chain ran and release-manifest check is clean

trace.outcome: Promotion Decision Tree gains recurrence-escalation to a durable owner; regen chain run
